name: Primum Non Nocere
source:
After losing your right to practice medicine, you slip away to the undergrounds of the city where the criminals and the poor made their homes.  It's a perfect home for someone like you, who is about to summon a demon to fix things. No matter the cost.

[From [url=https://catssautumn.itch.io/primum-non-nocere]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被吊销行医资格后，你悄然潜入城市地底——那里是罪犯与贫民安身立命的巢穴。对于像你这样正准备不惜一切代价召唤恶魔来扭转局面的人而言，这里无疑是最完美的栖身之所。

[摘自[url=https://catssautumn.itch.io/primum-non-nocere]itch.io[/url]]
